subject: MSA + Order Form: DPA redlines and transfer addendum (Starlite Health)
messages:
From: Marta Kuznetsova <marta.k@starlitehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Starlite Health Legal <legal@starlitehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MSA + Order Form redlines and DPA (initial)

Ben —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Attached are our redlines to the Master Services Agreement and an edited Data Processing Addendum with tracked SCCs and a short transfer addendum we included for EEA processing. High level items we flagged:

- Roles: we marked Starlite as controller and Redwood as processor but left an alternative language in case you want to propose a hybrid model.
- Liability / cap: proposed carveouts for security incidents affecting PHI.
- KMS / key custody: we added an ask that Redwood confirm whether keys can be customer-managed or at least BYOK options.
- SCCs: we added Appendix A with suggested ordering and a short exhibit mapping subprocessor categories.

We need a response that confirms: (1) whether Redwood can accept the DPA with our SCC insertions or propose a standard Redwood appendix, (2) whether you can provide KMS options and relevant SOC/ISO evidence, and (3) a timeline for finalizing the order form (we have a pilot starting 9/1).

Attachments: Starlite_MSA_Redlines.docx, Starlite_DPA_TrackChanges.docx

Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps — Marta

--
Marta Kuznetsova
Head of Legal, Starlite Health
marta.k@starlitehealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Kuznetsova <marta.k@starlitehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form redlines and DPA (initial)

Laura / Monica —

Looping you both in on Starlite's redlines (attached). Key asks from the customer: confirm controller/processor position for the MSA/DPA, review SCC insertions, and confirm KMS/BYOK capabilities (they want assurances for health data). Pilot start target is 2026-09-01 so they need the order form executed before then.

Specifics:
- Laura: can you review liability carveouts and the proposed changes to section 7 (indemnity & cap)? They flagged PHI exceptions and a higher carveout. Need to know what spectrum of concession we can offer.
- Monica: can you validate the SCC appendix and the subprocessor mapping they added? Also can you confirm the KMS options we can present (Redwood-managed keys vs. customer-managed via KMS integration) and what evidence we can provide (SOC2/AICPA scope, ISO27001)?

My proposed timeline: internal legal review today/tomorrow, then a short call with Starlite legal tomorrow afternoon if that works, final redline exchange on Tuesday 8/11, and DocuSign to follow.

I attached an internal checklist I use for MSA handbacks — feel free to add items.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Kuznetsova <marta.k@starlitehealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form redlines and DPA (initial)

Ben / Monica / Marta —

Thanks for the materials, Marta. I reviewed the tracked Word file and added inline comments — attaching Redwood_MSA_Response.docx. High-level position below:

1) Roles & SCCs
- We can accept the controller/processor characterization as stated. For SCCs we prefer to use Redwood's standard SCC exhibit (we will incorporate Starlite's mapping into Appendix 2 to avoid duplicative language).

2) Liability & PHI
- We cannot remove cap entirely; recommend a limited carveout for willful misconduct and gross negligence. For PHI-specific exceptions, propose a capped exception of 3x monthly recurring fees or $500k (whichever is greater) — we can be flexible on the number pending commercial review.

3) KMS / Encryption
- Redwood supports customer-managed keys via partner KMS (AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault) for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted API the default is Redwood-managed keys; we can offer BYOK on Dedicated or Private. Monica: please confirm the exact integrations and lead times for implementing BYOK for Dedicated.

4) Evidence requests
- We can provide SOC2 Type II report (redacted) and our ISO27001 certificate snapshots; I added a suggested language for an evidence delivery schedule in section 12.

5) Transfer addendum
- Starlite's short transfer addendum is okay in principle. We will propose small edits to the handoff paragraph to reflect pseudonymization scope for audit logs.

If this aligns we should: (a) incorporate our redline and send a consolidated file to Starlite, (b) schedule a 30-minute call tomorrow 8/10 at 3pm PT to walk through the remaining open bullets, and (c) target final redline exchange on 8/11.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Response.docx

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Starlite Health Legal <legal@starlitehealth.com>
From: Marta Kuznetsova <marta.k@starlitehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form redlines and DPA (initial)

Ben / Laura / Monica —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed notes, Laura. A couple quick replies:

- We are comfortable with the controller/processor acknowledgement and the idea of Redwood's SCC exhibit as the base, so long as our appendix mapping is preserved.
- Liability carveout: Starlite can accept a capped exception but would like to preserve a higher cap for PHI incidents — propose $1M carveout for PHI-specific breaches. Can you run that by commercial?
- KMS: We primarily expect Hosted API for the pilot but need an interim assurance that keys used for PHI are logically separated. If BYOK is only available for Dedicated/Private, what interim mitigations (e.g., encrypted-at-rest with customer-scoped roles / audit logs) can you offer?

We have uploaded a crosswalk of evidence we need (SOC2, ISO snapshot, subprocessor list) to the link below. Also here is a DocuSign envelope for the order form signature so we can lock the commercial once contract language is agreed: https://app.docusign.com/documents/envelope/0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h8i9j

If helpful, we can do the 3pm PT call today. Marta

Attachments: Starlite evidence request checklist (referenced in drive)

--
Marta Kuznetsova
Head of Legal, Starlite Health
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Kuznetsova <marta.k@starlitehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form redlines and DPA (initial) — next steps

Thanks everyone — good progress. Quick confirmation of next steps from Redwood side: 

1) Laura will finalize the redline with the edited liability language and appendix reference by end of day 8/11.
2) Monica will follow up on KMS/BYOK feasibility for Hosted vs Dedicated and provide a short note on mitigation controls for Hosted (audit logs, separation of duties, encryption-in-transit/rest) by 8/12.
3) I will schedule an internal commercial check to discuss the PHI cap ask ($1M) and come back with final commercial guidance on 8/12.

Proposed meeting: 8/12 9:30am PT — 30 minutes to finalize sign-off and DocuSign handoff. Marta, please confirm availability or propose alternate.

If all good, I will send the consolidated redline (incorporating Laura's edits) and a single-sheet summary for commercial sign-off. Thanks for moving quickly on this — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-internal-checklist.xlsx
